rationale: Builds on the current staged reverse-tail curriculum with a compact second schedule: late in training and at eval, the recurrent tail gradually refreshes its anchor toward the running recurrent state instead of using a fully frozen decoder-output anchor. This is a real structural change in the winning recurrent-tail family, not another scalar sweep, and it keeps compile-stable shapes while targeting the still-promising reverse-tail anchor variants.
title: Late Anchor-Mix Reverse Tail
